label: WRONG
reason: The primary class of each *.service.ts is *Service (SqsService, MetricsService/OtelMetricsService, AgentEmailInboxQuotaService), and biome.json useNamingConvention (warn) only checks case, so not TRIVIAL; but the rule covers every class in the file, and the outliers are supporting classes co-located with their service (PartialDispatchError in queue-base.service.ts, AgentEmailInboxQuotaExceededException, plus the unexported ConcurrencyPool helper in sqs-consumer.service.ts), a recurring category where renaming to *Service would be wrong, so new error/helper classes would draw false alarms; only QueueHealthIndicator (abstract base whose siblings are *.health-indicator.ts) merits a look, and its fix is the file name, not the class. Hesitated with ACCEPT since the service-class naming itself is a deliberate scheme.
